notes.title: Fall Announcements Time!
notes.content:
Hi, it's Ells&Pills!
Sorry if we've made you bored. Creating new games hasn't stopped, but it's hard to do more work than 4 hands allow :(
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45051997/145e82ff3d49c9f5049f7726366a8c3968cadaa2.jpg[/img]
Today we want to present you two new games that will soon be available on Steam:
[list]
[*] [b]Ells Tales: Idols[/b], the final game about the world of humanoid chickens with a quite unusual and strange ending. We've already said that all our games will be different, not just copied. This time you can expect a combination of horror and card game based on the rules of card soccer, with some fun innovations from us! 
If you've played the previous two games, it's time to add this game to your Wishlist! You won't have long to wait!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3234970/Ells_Tales_Idols/

[*] [b]Pigeon Hater[/b], our meme game-collaboration with references to our horror games. If you like to play trash-funny games and have nothing against dark humor, then welcome, now we have such a crazy game in our collection! Add it to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3151930/Pigeon_Hater/

[/list]
